# PrintPromo.ie

> Professional printing, promotional products and branded merchandise produced in Tallaght, Dublin.

## Core services

- Outdoor Display & Events
- Internal Display & Finishing
- Vehicle Wraps
- Sign Panels & Advertising
- Branded Glassware
- Large Format Print
- Last Minute Print
- Wall & Glass Manifestations

## Promotional products

- Apparel & Accessories
- Bags & Travel
- Eating & Drinking
- Seasonal Range
- Technology & Accessories
- Umbrellas & Rain Garments
- Eco Product Range
- Office & Writing
